finalText:
All 4 pass.

Leak: `processOrder.js` grab conn direct, no try/finally. Failed order (`run` reject) skip `pool.release` → conn stuck in `inUse` forever. Worker restart at 2am chew through fixed pool, `acquire()` throw "pool exhausted", service tip.

Fix: route through `withConnection` (same safe wrapper `api.js` already use, has finally-release). Comment about old retry-loop reason for direct acquire — no longer valid, wrapper works fine now.
